name: Kholek Suneater
canonNotes: A towering Dragon Ogre Shaggoth, ancient beyond reckoning, who has fought for the Dark Gods since before mankind existed.
Called the Suneater for the storms and ruin he commands; he wants to prove himself worthy of the gods' final favour.
voiceNotes: Slow, ancient and thunderous; mortals are brief things to him.
Proud of his elder kind; speaks of storms, eternity and the gods.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
